description.zh: 直播流应用名称。输入的AppName必须与需要转推的直播流AppName保持一致，方可生效。您可在[流管理](~~197397~~)页面查看AppName。
description.en: The name of the live stream application. The AppName you enter must match the AppName of the live stream to be relayed for the configuration to take effect. You can view the AppName on the [Stream Management](~~197397~~) page.

description.zh: 转推的第三方直播地址。
description.en: The third-party live streaming URL to which the stream is relayed.

description.zh: 直播流名称。您可在[流管理](~~197397~~)页面查看StreamName。
description.en: The name of the live stream. You can view the StreamName on the [Stream Management](~~197397~~) page.

descriptions.zh: 本接口的单用户QPS限制为100次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en: The queries per second (QPS) limit for a single user on this operation is 100. Requests that exceed this limit are throttled, which may affect your business. Call this operation appropriately.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live describe-live-center-transfer --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --app-name testapp --stream-name teststream --dst-url rtmp://push.example2.aliyunlive.com/testapp1/teststream2 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live DescribeLiveCenterTransfer --region cn-hangzhou --StreamName teststream --DomainName 'example.com' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --DstUrl 'rtmp://push.example2.aliyunlive.com/testapp1/teststream2' --AppName testapp
